scope: Entry provenance and manual daily evidence
Replay-only execution accounting and result diagnostics

verified_evidence.frozen_surface: Verification passes; active and historical reference surfaces match
verified_evidence.new_surface_bandit: No high-severity findings; bounded configured scan

review_findings: Deferred outcomes preserve ordering and commit accounting consumers together.
Restart, torn legacy saves, rejected entries and delayed receipts have meaningful coverage.
Every initial and pyramid buy requires its own qualified provenance receipt.
Collection boundaries, acquisition receipts and output aliases fail closed.
Replay alone installs simulated fill adapters; production DB verification remains strict.
Simulated outcomes retain explicit provenance and separate engine-close/pending diagnostics.
Frozen source groups, strategy settings and data feed remain unchanged.
final_acceptance_requires: Successful final full artifact pack, snapshots, invariant checks and audit index
Required PR and hosted acceptance checks
material_limits: No deployment or natural-session acceptance follows from source review.
Unresolved earliest closes intentionally delay later outcome accounting.
Downtime closes use first observed-flat time.
Atomic recovery does not guarantee recovery from failed storage.
Existing next-open simulation mutates positions synchronously; replay does not prove execution fidelity or profitability.
Missing receipts or incomplete session coverage withhold strategy results.
reviewer_actions: Read-only inspection; no tests, broker calls, source edits or runtime actions.
